one_line: SEO tool for keyword research, backlink analysis and rank tracking, exposed via a commercial REST API.
auth_notes: API v3 uses API keys created in account settings; OAuth 2.0 is only available through the 'Ahrefs Connect' partner integration program (requires application/approval)
self_serve_notes: Docs mention 'free test queries' to try endpoints without an Enterprise plan, but real API access requires a paid Ahrefs plan (Lite/Standard/Advanced/Enterprise); API keys self-managed in the dashboard once you have a paid subscription

api_surface.breadth_estimate: REST API v3 with ~40-50 endpoints across keyword, backlink, site explorer, rank tracker, site audit, content explorer and brand radar; OpenAPI spec published
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks used in Ahrefs Connect integrations (OAuth-based data delivery); no general user-facing webhook API

existing_mcp.note: Official Ahrefs MCP server documented in the fetched docs (MCP section with Claude Desktop/Web, ChatGPT and Claude Code setup guides)

evidence.note: fetched text confirms REST API, API keys, free test queries, MCP docs and OAuth (Ahrefs Connect)

agent_notes: Auth is simple API key; cost is the main friction ($$$ paid plans). MCP officially documented.
